name: Silver ear bobs
description: Ball-and-cone ear bobs of trade silver, one hanging from each ear lobe on a small wire loop.
history: Ball-and-cone ear bobs were common trade silver (Smith [P1], Heckewelder [P2], Jones [R2], [M11]); women often wore several in each ear (Jones counted ten [R2]).
provenance: Skeleton, bone names and bind pose: Actor_B rig converted from extracted game animation data (owner-stated authorization, see Player_Animation_Project/ASSET_AUTHORIZATION.md). Geometry generated procedurally by tools/character/garments/woodlands/ew_earbobs.py.
fabric_note: Fabric: approved Poly Haven CC0 kit (assets/polyhaven/textures/clothing), luminance detail tinted to the palette colour at runtime; UVs in metres along the grain.
review: Eastern Woodlands dress of living nations: needs paid review by the nations concerned (their cultural or historic-preservation offices) before public release; costume bible 3.7. No consultation has happened yet.
note: more ear bobs up the rim: a later variant

coverage.method: rays from the skin: the normal and 4 rays tilted 25 deg must hit the garment (>= 99.5 % of samples), on the female base and the male fit
